newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine industrial output to grow more than 5%.
newsitem.headline: Argentine industrial output to grow more than 5%.

text.p: Argentine industrial output will grow this year by more than five percent to a record level in the 28 years since it has been measured, Industry Secretary Alieto Guadagni said Thursday.
"This means we will be two percent above 1994 level and 10 percent over 1995," he told reporters.
Guadagni highlighted the sector's performance between 1990 and 1996 in which output grew at a yearly average of 4.5 percent, versus a two percent yearly average fall between 1981 and 1990.
But in spite of the 30 percent output growth between 1991 and 1996, the industrial employment level fell 17 percent over the same period, according to an official report.
Guadagni acknolwledged that 32,500 jobs in the industrial sector were lost in those years.
